The Reduced Coping Strategies Index (rCSI) is a consumption-based coping indicator. The index measures the frequency and severity of behavioural strategies that people apply when they cannot access enough food or when they foresee a decrease in food in the last seven days. The rCSI includes five standard strategies and allows for comparison across space, time, and population groups.


More details on the indicator can be found here: https://vamresources.manuals.wfp.org/docs/reduced-coping-strategies-index

 
# Indicator Calculation 


## rCSI

```{r}
# Label rCSI relevant variables -----------------------------------------------#

##check names

#Food02c - rCSILessQlty
#Food05c - rCSIBorrow
#Food08c- rCSIMealNb
# Food07c- rCSIMealAdult
# Food06c - rCSIMealSize


main$rCSILessQlty <- main$Food02c
main$rCSIBorrow <- main$Food05c
main$rCSIMealNb <- main$Food08c
main$rCSIMealAdult <- main$Food07c
main$rCSIMealSize <- main$Food06c

table(main$rCSILessQlty)
table(main$rCSIBorrow)
table(main$rCSIMealNb)
table(main$rCSIMealAdult)
table(main$rCSIMealSize)

```

```{r}

var_label(main$rCSILessQlty)  <- "Relied on less preferred and less expensive food"
var_label(main$rCSIBorrow)    <- "Borrowed food or relied on help from a relative or friend"
var_label(main$rCSIMealNb)    <- "Reduce number of meals eaten in a day"
var_label(main$rCSIMealSize)  <- "Limit portion size of meals at meal times"
var_label(main$rCSIMealAdult) <- "Restricted consumption by adults for small children to eat"

# Calculate rCSI --------------------------------------------------------------# 

main <- main %>%
  mutate(rCSI = rCSILessQlty + 
                              (rCSIBorrow * 2) + 
                               rCSIMealNb + 
                               rCSIMealSize + 
                              (rCSIMealAdult * 3))

var_label(main$rCSI)          <- "Reduced coping strategies index (rCSI)"

# Creating weighted and unweighted summary of rCSI ----------------------------# 

#unweighted
rCSI_table_mean <- main %>% 
  group_by(Intro_07) %>%
  drop_na(rCSI) %>% 
  summarise(meanrCSI = mean(rCSI))
  

```
